name: Andaz Pattaya Jomtien Beach
insider_take: This sleek beachfront escape perfectly balances Pattaya's vibrant energy with serene coastal luxury, offering an elevated perspective on Thailand's most dynamic beach destination.
whats_special: The Andaz Pattaya stands as the first Andaz property in Thailand, featuring striking contemporary architecture with floor-to-ceiling windows that frame panoramic views of Jomtien Beach. The hotel's rooftop infinity pool appears to merge seamlessly with the Gulf of Thailand, while its location on the quieter Jomtien Beach offers a more refined alternative to bustling Pattaya Beach just minutes away.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite on higher floors for unobstructed sunrise views over the gulf – the golden hour light reflecting off the water creates Instagram-worthy moments that capture Pattaya's softer side.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature restaurant showcases innovative Thai cuisine with ocean views, while the nearby Jomtien Night Market (just a 5-minute walk) offers authentic street food experiences. Take advantage of the complimentary beach activities and explore the Underwater World Pattaya aquarium, one of Thailand's largest, located just minutes from the hotel.
pros: Direct beachfront location on peaceful Jomtien Beach
Contemporary design with panoramic ocean views
Multiple dining venues including rooftop bar
Modern wellness facilities and infinity pool
cons: Distance from central Pattaya nightlife and attractions
Premium pricing for beachfront luxury positioning
